manifest.title: OpenKB
manifest.tagline: Open knowledge base on Drupal and Nuxt, with live collaboration and AI search
manifest.description:
OpenKB is an open-source knowledge base: a Drupal 11 backend with a decoupled
Nuxt frontend, real-time collaborative editing (Hocuspocus/Yjs), spaces with
page trees, and an optional AI chat with semantic search over your content.

This package runs the complete upstream stack in one app: the Nuxt frontend
on the main domain, Drupal on a second domain, MySQL from Cloudron, and a
bundled single-node OpenSearch for search and vector retrieval.
manifest.postInstallMessage:
The first start installs the Drupal site in the background, which takes a few
minutes. Until it is done, both domains show a "setting up" page.

* **Site:** $CLOUDRON-APP-ORIGIN
* **Admin:** the Drupal domain you chose, at `/user/login`, user `admin`

The admin password was generated on first start:

```
cloudron exec --app $CLOUDRON-APP-FQDN -- grep ADMIN_PASSWORD /app/data/.secrets.env
```

AI chat and semantic search need `OPENAI_API_KEY` in `/app/data/env.sh`.

ADMIN_DOMAIN.title: Drupal (admin & API) domain
ADMIN_DOMAIN.description: Drupal backend: admin UI, content API, OAuth, files. Must share a parent domain with the main domain, because the session cookie is scoped to it.

admin-login.message: Sign in on the **Drupal domain** at `/user/login` as `admin`. The password is in `/app/data/.secrets.env` (`cloudron exec -- grep ADMIN_PASSWORD /app/data/.secrets.env`), or get a one-time link with `cloudron exec -- drush uli`.

ai-key.message: AI chat and semantic search stay off until `OPENAI_API_KEY` is set in `/app/data/env.sh`. Restart the app afterwards, then run `cloudron exec -- drush search-api:reset-tracker kb_chunks -y`.
